data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER programs_fts_update
  AFTER UPDATE OF title, subtitle, description ON epg_programs
  WHEN old.title IS NOT new.title
    OR old.subtitle IS NOT new.subtitle
    OR old.description IS NOT new.description
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO programs_fts(programs_fts, rowid, title, subtitle, description)
    VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.title, old.subtitle, old.description);
  INSERT INTO programs_fts(rowid, title, subtitle, description)
    VALUES (new.id, new.title, new.subtitle, new.description);
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "library_folders" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_download_folder" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_download_folder" IN (0, 1)), "is_available" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_available" IN (0, 1)), "last_scan_at" TEXT NULL, "added_at" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sources" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "username" TEXT NULL, "credential_ref" TEXT NULL, "epg_url" TEXT NULL, "user_agent" TEXT NULL, "live_format" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ts', "epg_offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "refresh_hours" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 12, "max_connections_override" INTEGER NULL, "account_json" TEXT NULL, "expires_at" TEXT NULL, "last_synced_at" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "library_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "folder_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES library_folders (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "rel_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mtime" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quick_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "show_title" TEXT NULL, "season" INTEGER NULL, "episode" INTEGER NULL, "episode_end" INTEGER NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "probe_json" TEXT NULL, "thumbnail_path" TEXT NULL, "artwork_path" TEXT NULL, "subtitles_json" TEXT NULL, "user_edits_json" TEXT NULL, "details_json" TEXT NULL, "provider_source_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "provider_item_type" TEXT NULL, "provider_remote_key" TEXT NULL, "provider_series_key" TEXT NULL, "is_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_hidden" IN (0, 1)), "unavailable_since" TEXT NULL, "added_at" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("folder_id", "rel_path"));
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "library_fts" USING fts5(title, show_title, content='library_items', content_rowid='id', tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2', prefix='2 3');
CREATE TRIGGER library_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON library_items BEGIN INSERT INTO library_fts ("rowid", title, show_title) VALUES (new.id, new.title, new.show_title);END
CREATE TRIGGER library_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON library_items BEGIN INSERT INTO library_fts (library_fts, "rowid", title, show_title) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.title, old.show_title);END

CREATE TRIGGER library_fts_update AFTER UPDATE OF title, show_title ON library_items WHEN old.title IS NOT new.title OR old.show_title IS NOT new.show_title BEGIN INSERT INTO library_fts (library_fts, "rowid", title, show_title) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.title, old.show_title);INSERT INTO library_fts ("rowid", title, show_title) VALUES (new.id, new.title, new.show_title);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorite_groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "collapsed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("collapsed" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorites" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "item_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "remote_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES favorite_groups (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NULL, "added_at" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("item_type", "source_id", "remote_key"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX favorites_local ON favorites (item_type, remote_key) WHERE source_id IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "watch_history" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "item_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "remote_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "position_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("completed" IN (0, 1)), "series_key" TEXT NULL, "dismissed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("dismissed" IN (0, 1)), "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("item_type", "source_id", "remote_key"));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX watch_history_local ON watch_history (item_type, remote_key) WHERE source_id IS NULL
CREATE INDEX watch_history_recent ON watch_history (item_type, updated_at)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "downloads" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "item_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "series_remote_key" TEXT NULL, "season" INTEGER NULL, "episode" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "show_title" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "artwork_url" TEXT NULL, "target_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "total_bytes" INTEGER NULL, "downloaded_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "etag" TEXT NULL, "last_modified" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_class" TEXT NULL, "error_detail" TEXT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "library_item_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES library_items (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("source_id", "item_type", "remote_key"));
CREATE INDEX library_items_hash ON library_items (quick_hash)
CREATE INDEX library_items_kind_title ON library_items (kind, title)
CREATE INDEX library_items_provider ON library_items (provider_source_id, provider_item_type, provider_remote_key)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "remote_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "seen_run" INTEGER NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "is_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_hidden" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("source_id", "kind", "remote_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "channels" ("source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "remote_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "seen_run" INTEGER NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "number" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "clean_name" TEXT NULL, "quality" TEXT NULL, "logo_url" TEXT NULL, "epg_key" TEXT NULL, "archive_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "stream_url" TEXT NULL, "extras_json" TEXT NULL, "is_hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_hidden" IN (0, 1)), "added_at" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("source_id", "remote_key"));
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "channels_fts" USING fts5(clean_name, display_name, content='channels', content_rowid='id', tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2', prefix='2 3');
CREATE TRIGGER channels_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON channels BEGIN INSERT INTO channels_fts ("rowid", clean_name, display_name) VALUES (new.id, new.clean_name, new.display_name);END

CREATE TRIGGER channels_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON channels BEGIN INSERT INTO channels_fts (channels_fts, "rowid", clean_name, display_name) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.clean_name, old.display_name);END

CREATE TRIGGER channels_fts_update AFTER UPDATE OF clean_name, display_name ON channels WHEN old.clean_name IS NOT new.clean_name OR old.display_name IS NOT new.display_name BEGIN INSERT INTO channels_fts (channels_fts, "rowid", clean_name, display_name) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.clean_name, old.display_name);INSERT INTO channels_fts ("rowid", clean_name, display_name) VALUES (new.id, new.clean_name, new.display_name);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movies" ("source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "remote_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "seen_run" INTEGER NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "poster_url" TEXT NULL, "rating" REAL NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "ext" TEXT NULL, "stream_url" TEXT NULL, "extras_json" TEXT NULL, "added_at" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("source_id", "remote_key"));
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movies_fts" USING fts5(name, content='movies', content_rowid='id', tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2', prefix='2 3');
CREATE TRIGGER movies_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON movies BEGIN INSERT INTO movies_fts ("rowid", name) VALUES (new.id, new.name);END
CREATE TRIGGER movies_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON movies BEGIN INSERT INTO movies_fts (movies_fts, "rowid", name) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.name);END

CREATE TRIGGER movies_fts_update AFTER UPDATE OF name ON movies WHEN old.name IS NOT new.name BEGIN INSERT INTO movies_fts (movies_fts, "rowid", name) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.name);INSERT INTO movies_fts ("rowid", name) VALUES (new.id, new.name);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series" ("source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "remote_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "seen_run" INTEGER NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "poster_url" TEXT NULL, "rating" REAL NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "plot" TEXT NULL, "genre" TEXT NULL, "cast_names" TEXT NULL, "director" TEXT NULL, "backdrop_url" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "episodes_fetched_at" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("source_id", "remote_key"));
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "series_fts" USING fts5(name, content='series', content_rowid='id', tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2', prefix='2 3');
CREATE TRIGGER series_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON series BEGIN INSERT INTO series_fts ("rowid", name) VALUES (new.id, new.name);END
CREATE TRIGGER series_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON series BEGIN INSERT INTO series_fts (series_fts, "rowid", name) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.name);END

CREATE TRIGGER series_fts_update AFTER UPDATE OF name ON series WHEN old.name IS NOT new.name BEGIN INSERT INTO series_fts (series_fts, "rowid", name) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.name);INSERT INTO series_fts ("rowid", name) VALUES (new.id, new.name);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "epg_programs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "epg_channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtitle" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL);
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "programs_fts" USING fts5(title, subtitle, description, content='epg_programs', content_rowid='id', tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2', prefix='2 3');
CREATE TRIGGER programs_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON epg_programs BEGIN INSERT INTO programs_fts ("rowid", title, subtitle, description) VALUES (new.id, new.title, new.subtitle, new.description);END

CREATE TRIGGER programs_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON epg_programs BEGIN INSERT INTO programs_fts (programs_fts, "rowid", title, subtitle, description) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.title, old.subtitle, old.description);END

CREATE TRIGGER programs_fts_update AFTER UPDATE OF title, subtitle, description ON epg_programs WHEN old.title IS NOT new.title OR old.subtitle IS NOT new.subtitle OR old.description IS NOT new.description BEGIN INSERT INTO programs_fts (programs_fts, "rowid", title, subtitle, description) VALUES ('delete', old.id, old.title, old.subtitle, old.description);INSERT INTO programs_fts ("rowid", title, subtitle, description) VALUES (new.id, new.title, new.subtitle, new.description);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "epg_imports" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "finished_at" TEXT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running', "failure" TEXT NULL, "failure_status" INTEGER NULL, "counts_json" TEXT NULL, "is_live" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_live" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "epg_channels" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "xmltv_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "icon_url" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("source_id", "xmltv_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "epg_channels_staging" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "import_run" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES epg_imports (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "xmltv_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "icon_url" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("import_run", "xmltv_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "epg_programs_staging" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "import_run" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES epg_imports (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "epg_channel_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtitle" TEXT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "epg_mappings" ("source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "channel_remote_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "xmltv_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "channel_remote_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "epg_matches" ("channel_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES channels (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "xmltv_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("channel_id"));
CREATE INDEX epg_programs_channel_start ON epg_programs (source_id, epg_channel_id, start_utc)
CREATE INDEX epg_programs_staging_run ON epg_programs_staging (import_run)
CREATE INDEX epg_matches_source ON epg_matches (source_id, xmltv_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_runs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "finished_at" TEXT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running', "failure" TEXT NULL, "failure_status" INTEGER NULL, "counts_json" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movie_details" ("movie_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES movies (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "plot" TEXT NULL, "cast_names" TEXT NULL, "director" TEXT NULL, "genre" TEXT NULL, "runtime_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "backdrop_url" TEXT NULL, "video_height" INTEGER NULL, "audio_channels" INTEGER NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("movie_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "episodes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "series_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES series (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "remote_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "ext" TEXT NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "plot" TEXT NULL, "still_url" TEXT NULL, "stream_url" TEXT NULL, "extras_json" TEXT NULL, "seen_run" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("series_id", "remote_key"));
CREATE INDEX categories_source_kind ON categories (source_id, kind)
CREATE INDEX channels_category ON channels (category_id)
CREATE INDEX movies_category ON movies (category_id)
CREATE INDEX movies_added ON movies (source_id, added_at, id)
CREATE INDEX movies_name ON movies (source_id, name COLLATE NOCASE, id)
CREATE INDEX movies_rating ON movies (source_id, rating DESC, name COLLATE NOCASE, id)
CREATE INDEX series_category ON series (category_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cast_devices" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "last_host" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_port" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 8009, "is_manual" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_manual" IN (0, 1)), "hevc_support" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'auto', "learned_json" TEXT NULL, "last_used_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id"));
